core.script.title: JavaScript sandbox

core.preview.title: Preview

core.config.title: Experiment configuration
core.config.description: Validate a partial config and produce a complete PyTorch experiment config.

core.dataset.title: Custom dataset
core.dataset.description: Build finite float32 input/target samples without executing training.

core.experiment.title: Create experiment
core.experiment.description: Create an independent real PyTorch experiment; optionally import custom data.

core.train.title: Train
core.train.description: Execute real training steps. Cancellation is checked between completed steps.

core.branch.title: Branch experiment
core.branch.description: Branch exact live parameter, optimizer, scheduler, data and observation state.

core.checkpoint.title: Capture checkpoint
core.checkpoint.description: Capture a complete real training checkpoint on the selected run.

core.inspect.title: Inspect experiment
core.inspect.description: Read an actual recorded step or the live run snapshot; optionally include data.

core.intervene.title: Manual intervention
core.intervene.description: Explicitly edit finite parameter/LR or supported optimizer memory on a real paused run.

core.verify.title: Verify record chain
core.verify.description: Verify the actual immutable numerical record hash chain.

core.control.title: Experiment control
core.control.description: Explicitly play, pause, reset live state, or restart an existing experiment.

core.export.title: Export evidence
core.export.description: Generate and retain an immutable ZIP of actual numerical evidence, bound to this execution.

hf.config.title: HF model configuration
hf.config.description: Create an offline AutoConfig recipe. No model download or remote code.

hf.model.title: HF AutoModel
hf.model.description: Instantiate an actual supported HF model from config after a meta-device parameter budget check.

hf.pretrained.title: Cached HF pretrained model
hf.pretrained.description: Load actual cached safetensors weights by public Hub repository and pinned commit. No downloads, arbitrary paths, remote code or pickle.

hf.auto_tokenizer.title: Cached HF AutoTokenizer
hf.auto_tokenizer.description: Load a matching cached fast tokenizer by repository and pinned Hub commit. Never imports remote tokenizer code.

hf.tokenizer.title: Local HF fast tokenizer
hf.tokenizer.description: Build a real offline WordLevel PreTrainedTokenizerFast from an editable vocabulary.

hf.tokenize.title: Tokenize text
hf.tokenize.description: Tokenize and pad text; causal labels mask padding with -100.

hf.data.title: Tensor dataset
hf.data.description: Finite named tensor batches: x/labels for custom models or input_ids/attention_mask/labels for HF.

hf.layer.title: Layer recipe
hf.layer.description: A declarative PyTorch layer. Connect recipes into Compose layers / Sequential / custom forward.

hf.linear.title: Linear
hf.linear.description: Trainable dense projection with arbitrary bounded input/output width.

hf.rmsnorm.title: RMSNorm
hf.rmsnorm.description: Actual torch.nn.RMSNorm. Normalization connects to layer outputs; optimizers bind the complete model.

hf.attention.title: Self attention
hf.attention.description: Trainable batch-first multi-head self attention with optional causal masking.

hf.compose.title: Compose layers
hf.compose.description: Join two layer recipes or composed layer lists. Connect the layers output to Sequential.

hf.stack.title: Append layer
hf.stack.description: Append an individual layer to a layer list.

hf.sequential.title: Sequential model
hf.sequential.description: Instantiate a real multi-parameter PyTorch architecture from ordered layer recipes.

hf.custom.title: Custom tensor forward
hf.custom.description: Editable restricted Python tensor expressions and named trainable layers. No imports, attributes, loops, eval or exec.

parameters.name: code

hf.optimizer.title: Optimizer
hf.optimizer.description: Optimizer recipe. Connect to Train alongside a model; AdamW updates the model's complete parameter set.

hf.train.title: Train multi-parameter model
hf.train.description: Actual autograd/optimizer updates, finite loss checks, gradient clipping, measured parameter hashes and loss history.

hf.forward.title: Forward pass
hf.forward.description: Run a real model forward; tensors remain in the job worker and expose shape/dtype/value previews.

hf.evaluate.title: Evaluate model
hf.evaluate.description: Evaluate a finite loss and optional classification accuracy without changing weights.

hf.generate.title: HF generate
hf.generate.description: Real bounded HF autoregressive generation with attention masks and deterministic default sampling.

hf.pipeline.title: HF pipeline
hf.pipeline.description: Actual Transformers pipeline with a job-local model/tokenizer, offline inference and bounded inputs.

hf.inspect.title: Inspect model
hf.inspect.description: Real parameter names, shapes, trainable counts, architecture, finite checks and weight hash.

hf.checkpoint.title: Export safe model
hf.checkpoint.description: Immutable ZIP with safetensors weights and a declarative architecture recipe. No pickle or executable model code.

hf.load.title: Load safe model
hf.load.description: Load only a registered graph artifact, verify safe ZIP/recipe/safetensors and rebuild within model budgets.

local.transformer.recipes/mlp_layers.title: Custom MLP architecture
local.transformer.recipes/mlp_layers.description: Generate a bounded dense/RMSNorm/GELU/dense architecture. Optional panel controls override the width parameter.

inputs.name: controls
inputs.description: Optional object from the reusable controls panel; width selects hidden features.

outputs.name: layers
outputs.description: Validated layer recipes for a real Sequential model.
